description: Provides UCOS repository artifacts as attested, content-hashed resources. Reference implementation of the Universal Provider Architecture.

capabilities.name: repository.artifacts
capabilities.description: Enumerate repository artifacts matching a path/name selector.

capabilities.name: repository.artifact
capabilities.description: Resolve one repository artifact by its repository-relative path.

capabilities.name: repository.attestation
capabilities.description: Attest a repository artifact's content hash and provenance chain.

config_schema.root: absolute path to the repository working tree
config_schema.patterns: list of glob patterns applied relative to root
